summary: Define versioned phone-number, evidence, and assessment schemas
description: Create the machine contracts that keep technical facts, lookup demand, identity claims, and call reports separate.
acceptance: R-1: Schemas distinguish canonical number facts, source observations, community reports, and computed assessments.
R-2: Every assessment requires provenance, freshness, confidence, reason codes, and residual-risk wording.

review_history.evidence: R-1 approved: four strict schemas use distinct kind discriminators, call reports remain unverified displayed-number observations, lookup demand cannot enter assessments, and identity evidence is restricted from public results. R-2 approved: assessment schema requires provenance, freshness, confidence, reason codes, evidence-linked conclusions, and spoofing-aware residual-risk wording. Fifteen focused tests and all twenty-eight repository tests pass.

evidence.summary: changed_files=schemas/phone-number.schema.json,schemas/source-evidence.schema.json,schemas/lookup-result.schema.json,schemas/call-report.schema.json,tests/contracts/test_domain_contracts.py; verification=jq empty schemas/phone-number.schema.json schemas/source-evidence.schema.json schemas/lookup-result.schema.json schemas/call-report.schema.json && uv run pytest tests/contracts -q && uv run ruff check tests/contracts && make check && ./go validate . && git diff --check rc=0; critic=passed domain-model review confirmed separate kinds for number facts, source evidence, community reports, and computed assessments; public lookup rejects restricted identity claims and lookup counts; every assessment requires confidence, reasons, provenance, freshness, and spoofing residual risk
